description: Moonshine Streaming is among the least-proven exports under ORT Web. Validate sliding-window streaming loop end-to-end (features, upload, decode, readback), static shapes, GPU-buffer residency for KV cache (preferredOutputLocation gpu-buffer). Include per-language Small checkpoints (ja etc.). Desktop evidence: the Moonshine Medium dynamic-int8 encoder puts ~150 MatMulInteger/DynamicQuantizeLinear nodes on CPU (282 ms WebGPU vs 18 ms WASM), so a GPU-friendly export (fp16/q4) is needed.
title: Benchmark live STT (Moonshine Streaming Medium/Small/Tiny, Whisper Small/Tiny) on WebGPU
